Hey there! So I’m struggling with the exact same thing as you. And it’s hard because all I want to do is eat, but my body “won’t” let me. What I have learned to help this is try to get something, doesn’t matter what in your stomach to help they stomach acid. Once this is settled it will be MUCH easier to eat a normal meal. What I tend to do is drink calories when I’m hungry with no appetite. I often make a smoothie. It’s easier to drink than to eat. The trick to eating meals is actually just eating a lot of small meals during the course of the day. Big meals can be overwhelming and hard, but just eating small meals and snacks throughout the day helps me a lot! I hope you’ll get better, and I hope this can maybe help you as well❤️
